buildchain-ref.description: Optional Buildchain runtime ref. Empty uses v3.

target-branch.description: Protected dev branch to merge ready PRs into

expected-pr-number.description: Optional exact PR number for targeted Agent admission; requires expected-head-sha

expected-head-sha.description: Exact 40-character PR head required for targeted Agent admission

diagnostic-context.description: Commit-status context used for PR-visible targeted admission state

delivery-warrant-mode.description: Delivery Warrant rollout: off, shadow (read-only queue plan), or required

source-patch-root.description: Immutable source patch or tree-intent root

project-cut-proof-json.description: Optional exact rooted Project Cut replay proof required when GitHub reports the PR behind the current protected base

affected-paths-json.description: JSON array of paths covered by source qualification

shard-evidence-roots-json.description: JSON array of additional source-shard evidence roots

delivery-priority.description: Reviewed priority: ordinary, expedited, or emergency

required-status-checks.description: Comma or newline separated required status/check-run name fragments

queue-admission-context.description: Temporary exact-head commit status required before native queue admission

ready-label.description: Required label for PRs eligible to merge. Empty disables the label gate.

block-labels.description: Comma or newline separated labels that block merging

allowed-head-prefixes.description: Comma or newline separated allowed source branch prefixes

require-approval.description: Require at least one current approval and no latest changes-requested review

same-repository-only.description: Reject fork/cross-repository PR heads by default

max-merges.description: Maximum PRs to merge in one run

merge-method.description: GitHub merge method: merge, squash, or rebase

landing-mode.description: Landing mode: auto selects native queue when enabled; queue fails closed without one

dry-run.description: Plan only; do not merge PRs

github-token.description: Optional token for reading and merging PRs. Defaults to github.token.

merged-count.description: Number of PRs directly merged, or directly eligible in dry-run mode

enqueued-count.description: Number of PRs admitted into the native merge queue

action-count.description: Number of direct merges, queue admissions, or planned actions

final-base-sha.description: Final target branch SHA after the run

admission-state.description: Typed targeted admission state; empty for cadence patrol

admission-receipt-root.description: Content root of the targeted exact-head admission receipt

source-proof-root.description: Content root of the reusable Source Qualification Proof

warrant-receipt-root.description: Content root of the selected Delivery Warrant receipt

warrant-state-root.description: Exact readback root of the durable Warrant queue

warrant-state-commit.description: Immutable queue commit containing the active Warrant readback

project-cut-proof-root.description: Verified exact Project Cut replay proof root, when supplied
